entries.title: Agent developer
entries.text: Builds shopping or API-consuming agents; wants clear SDKs, errors and test modes.

entries.title: AI surface product lead
entries.text: Runs a chat or search surface (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot); wants conversion, trust and clear liability.

entries.title: API, data or compute seller
entries.text: Wants per-request or metered payment with no accounts and low fees.

entries.title: The agent as an economic actor
entries.text: Discovers, pays, proves and gets rated; the machine persona.

entries.title: CDN or bot-management engineer
entries.text: Verifies signatures at the edge and separates good agents from bad bots.

entries.title: Compliance officer or regulator
entries.text: KYC, KYB, KYA, AML, consumer protection, AI rules.

entries.title: Delegating consumer
entries.text: Wants an agent to buy for them without losing control, refunds or privacy.

entries.title: Agent controls platform builder (the owner)
entries.text: 0xVitalii, founder of merces.ai, builds the controls platform for agentic transactions: a Risk Check, a registry of real agents, monitoring and policy enforcem…

entries.title: Payment facilitator or relay operator
entries.text: Verifies and settles, pays gas, screens sanctions.

entries.title: Fraud and risk analyst
entries.text: Signals, scores, chargebacks, agent abuse patterns.

entries.title: Card issuer risk and product lead
entries.text: Authorization decisions, fraud, disputes, Regulation E exposure.

entries.title: Enterprise commerce architect
entries.text: Wants control, merchant-of-record status, customer data and predictable integration cost.

entries.title: Small merchant on a platform
entries.text: Wants agent sales with near-zero integration work and no new fraud.

entries.title: Card network product owner
entries.text: Token standards, rules, ecosystem programs.

entries.title: PSP or acquirer product lead
entries.text: Tokens, routing, risk, fees, and support for many protocols at once.

entries.title: Academic researcher
entries.text: Measurement, economics, formal analysis.

entries.title: Security researcher or red teamer
entries.text: Breaks protocols and implementations, writes advisories.

entries.title: Validator, auditor or attestor
entries.text: Re-execution, zkML or TEE attestation, reputation services.

entries.title: Wallet or credential provider
entries.text: Holds credentials, captures consent, issues tokens (Google Pay, PayPal, Coinbase).
